public_rationale: Research available before the post identifies multiple distinct risks matching the listed categories. It also explains how broad reuse propagates model defects and how limited understanding complicates anticipating and controlling harm. This supports the ordinary claim about risks and contributing mechanisms. It does not establish that every harm is inevitable or that these are the only causes.
limitations: The evidence includes scientific syntheses and a preprint, rather than one experiment testing the entire claim.
Employment disruption does not imply a proven net loss of jobs.
Defamation risk does not establish legal liability in any particular case.
The claim gives no numerical magnitude or exclusive causal model.

our_interpretation: Assess the substantive risk claim as it stood when posted on 2024-08-20; the reference to Senate testimony is background.
The ordinary reading concerns credible risks, not a claim that every harm has occurred everywhere or that net employment losses are inevitable.

Read the causal explanation as saying that broad applicability spreads exposure to different harms and limited understanding makes those harms harder to anticipate and control. It does not identify these as the only causes.
Recent techniques principally refers to generative AI and foundation models in this context.
